meta.name: Sector-Adaptive Dividend Low-Vol ETF Candidate V5.7b
meta.objective: Build a diversified enhanced ETF-like basket where non-financial sleeves are anchored to operating cash-flow yield and financial sleeves use dividend and bank-quality evidence.

universe.name: PIT candidate pool from bank, utilities/electricity, highway infrastructure and port/rail infrastructure sleeves
universe.construction: Only sleeves with PIT panels, real daily open/close prices and cash-dividend files enter the official basket. Financial sleeves are not blocked by non-financial OCF fields.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT panels, reviewed sector evidence where available, and JoinQuant real daily open/close execution prices
data.cash_dividend_policy: real cash dividends from JoinQuant STK_XR_XD, net_cash_per_share after 20% tax
data.derived_field_policy: dividend_yield_decimal normalizes percent-vs-decimal source units; bank quality fields are financial-sector-only evidence.

signals.core_hypothesis: A cross-sector high-dividend low-volatility basket should use sector-adapted evidence: OCF yield for non-financial operating businesses, dividend and bank balance-sheet quality for banks, and low-volatility/drawdown controls for all sleeves.

validation.acceptance_rule: PM cannot accept the ETF candidate from 2021-2026 platform-confirmation returns alone. Promotion requires stable evidence, clean data gates, platform attribution and paper trading.
